svg.title: utility — crop of revision 03, front toward bottom
svg.text: Existing room boundaries and opening coordinates retained • front / street at bottom
Furniture drawn to the same scale • nominal zones, not finished clear dimensions
L1 — Primary sofa 7.5 × 3 ft; faces TV
T1 — Dining table 6 × 3 ft, six seats
P1 — Bed frame 7 × 5.5 ft; head right
G1 — Bed frame 5.5 × 7 ft; head front
Blue dashed line = primary TV sightline.
Window shading is proposed, not sun-tested.
D/S opening tags retain original meanings.
Furniture IDs are separate from door IDs.
No exterior window moved or added.
Bathroom fixtures not yet laid out.
* Foyer/dining edges require final wall check.
Do not order furniture from nominal zones.
Scale reference: one drawn foot = 22 SVG units. Plan room zones and openings retained; furniture is proposed.
Next: verify finished dimensions, door operation, columns and appliances before generating matched room views.
